# NKY Handyman Pros

## About
NKY Handyman Pros provides handyman services for homeowners, landlords, and small businesses in Northern Kentucky (Boone, Kenton, and Campbell counties): general home repairs, fixture installation, and honey-do lists. Jobs that need a permit or a licensed electrician or plumber are referred out.

## Services
- General home repairs (drywall patching, door repairs, trim work, caulking)
- Fixture installation (ceiling fans, light fixtures, faucets, toilets, TV mounting, shelving)
- Honey-do lists handled in one visit when possible
- Free estimates; ballpark pricing over the phone for most jobs

## Service Areas
Florence KY, Covington KY, Fort Thomas KY, Newport KY, Fort Mitchell KY, Erlanger KY, Edgewood KY, Independence KY.
